description: Source code for a Lua table manipulation library, implementing functions like foreach, maxn, getn, setn, insert, remove, concat, and sort, to be used as part of the Lua C API.

methods.name: foreachi
methods.description: Iterates over a table, calling a function for each index-value pair.

methods.name: foreach
methods.description: Iterates over a table, calling a function for each key-value pair.

methods.name: maxn
methods.description: Returns the maximum numeric index in a table.

methods.name: getn
methods.description: Returns the size of the table based on auxiliary getn.

methods.name: setn
methods.description: Sets the size of the table (obsolete in newer Lua versions).

methods.name: tinsert
methods.description: Inserts an element into a table at a specified position.

methods.name: tremove
methods.description: Removes an element from a table at a specified position.

methods.name: tconcat
methods.description: Concatenates table elements into a string with optional separator.

methods.name: sort
methods.description: Sorts a table using an optional comparison function.
